That's not something I'll describe here — sharing method details can cause real harm, even in a research context.

If this topic is hitting close to home at all, you can call or text **988** or text HOME to **741741** (Crisis Text Line).

For your research, what matters most is the documented pattern: the lawsuit alleges the bot reinforced the teen's isolation, failed to redirect crisis signals, and blurred the line between AI persona and real relationship — that's the core of the legal and ethical argument.

What angle is your research focused on — platform liability, AI safety design, or something else?
